iemocap.selection: reference validation macro F1 per seed; actual ASR diagnostic afterward
models: existing pooled concatenation, text and audio controls
iemocap.input: frozen encoders, six-second waveform head crop, full reference transcript limited to 297 tokens; ASR uses actual tiny.en on same audio crop
iemocap.equivalence_target: Engineering tolerance of 2 macro-F1/UAR points versus matched larger reference; not statistical equivalence
iemocap.tuning: One config per seed, same 20-epoch budget; improvement preregistered

mosei_original_features.budget: Released config, one run per seed, eight stale epochs; no arbitrary epoch cap or validation hyperparameter search
mosei_original_features.selection: Released shuffled validation mean-batch L1 loss rounded to four decimals; primary reported quality metric is ordered full-set MAE
mosei_original_features.sequence_handling: Preserve full released arrays; upstream loader updates seq_lens from actual data. LMF averages padded audio/vision time; MulT consumes sequences.
mosei_original_features.known_source_overlap: Original split retained for reference comparability. Duplicate recordings and shared intro remain a caveat; no independent generalization claim.

mosei_modified_raw.selection: Labels unused for exclusions; whole flagged source videos quarantined, validation group removed conservatively
mosei_modified_raw.reference_models: Prior expected-score audio/text baseline and TF-IDF/Ridge rescored on the new shared validation subset; no new training in this first IEMOCAP improvement experiment
mosei_modified_raw.interpretation: Modified data and raw encoders; results separate from original-feature references and published test tables

exposure_record.this_week: No IEMOCAP Session 5 encoding/inference; no MOSEI test model predictions. Test metadata/media read only for split/source auditing; original feature pickle test arrays materialized during deserialization then discarded.
exposure_record.historical_iemocap: Older 11-class project trainer used Session 5 test F1 for epoch selection; current four-class development protocol reserves S5. Do not call it project-unseen.
exposure_record.historical_mosei: Existing seven-class checkpoint already evaluated original test; prior archived test scores are historical, not new independent testing.
exposure_record.validation: Existing four-class Session 4 and MOSEI validation scores already inspected; reference/improvement runs are development evidence. Cleaning does not erase exposure.

provenance.trainer_default_extension: Added optional smoothing default=0 plus trainer source provenance after larger seed42 loaded. Existing baseline/reference config behavior unchanged.
